verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some inherently batched operations: contractor payment groups, created and validated via a single preview endpoint, pay many contractors at once. Regular payrolls are pre-generated per pay schedule and cover a whole team. The agent-friendly CLI drafts per-cycle payroll across employees and contractors in one session. There is no documented general-purpose bulk or batch API for creating, updating or deleting many arbitrary items in one call; pagination only supports bulk reads. Missing for 10: generic bulk/batch write endpoints, bulk operations beyond payroll and contractor payment groups, documented batch limits or partial-failure handling, independent hands-on corroboration.
